title: Riesz transforms and rectifiability in higher codimension

result.label: Riesz transforms and rectifiability in higher codimension
result.statement: Resolves the remaining higher-codimension Riesz-transform rectifiability problem: for d ≥ 4 and 2 n d-2, an n -Ahlfors–David regular Radon measure on ℝ d is uniformly n -rectifiable whenever its n -dimensional Riesz transform is uniformly L 2 -bounded over all positive hard truncations. The rectifiability bounds depend only on dimension, regularity and operator bounds.
